paragraph: Nicole and Gary Wordsworth spent fifteen years taking in part-time pups from a dogs home in Buckinghamshire. They did this while working from home, designing electronics, and now they continue in retirement. Fifty-nine dogs have slept on their floors and returned happier for it. The couple is in their sixties now. They say they love getting the animals out of the kennels. They plan to keep going.
